# Assassin
[color=#999999][italic]"Mission Started."[/italic][/color]
You're a [color=orange]Assassin[/color], sent by SolGov to assassinate a person of inconvenience to them. [color=cyan]SolGov wants you to kill them in a very particular way.[/color] Pay attention to your conditions.
# Your Gear
You are equipped with a briefcase capable of teleporting in a variety of equipment to help you assassinate your target. You only get to pick two of the kits so choose wisely
# The Mission Your objective is to assassinate a member of the station. However, there are certain constraints you must fulfill in While doing this. Be sure to execute the assassination according the specifications given to you via your contract.
